hooks.command: cat >/dev/null || true; repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$repo_root/Tools/Invoke-CodeReviewGraph.ps1" update --skip-flows || true
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$null = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $d = (Get-Location).Path; while ($true) { $launcher = Join-Path $d 'Tools/Invoke-CodeReviewGraph.ps1'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $launcher -PathType Leaf) { break }; $parent = [System.IO.Directory]::GetParent($d); if ($null -eq $parent) { exit 0 }; $d = $parent.FullName }; try { & $launcher update --skip-flows } catch { Write-Warning $_; exit 0 }"
